bullets.section: What I’m excited about (and my most important bullet in a long time) —
bullets.title: My brand-new TED talk
bullets.note:
!
This 14-minute talk was given on the TED main stage during the opening session
a few weeks ago, and [it’s finally
live](https://el2.fourhourmail.com/c/o8uvgq544hqhke7vx/q1opyg/aHR0cHM6Ly93d3cudGVkLmNvbS90YWxrcy90aW1fZmVycmlzc193aHlfeW91X3Nob3VsZF9kZWZpbmVfeW91cl9mZWFyc19pbnN0ZWFkX29mX3lvdXJfZ29hbHM=).
It’s the most important and vulnerable talk I’ve ever given, touching on
subjects like suicide. Oddly, the exercise I describe -- “fear-setting” -- has
also led to nearly all of my best investments and business successes. Step-by-
step instructions and real-world examples can be found [in this
post](https://el2.fourhourmail.com/c/o8uvgq544hqhke7vx/x1zvjk/aHR0cDovL3RpbS5ibG9nLzIwMTcvMDUvMTUvZmVhci1zZXR0aW5nLw==).
There’s a lot of darkness in the world, but certain tools can help. Thank you
for sharing the talk with someone it might help. Last but not least, and among
many others, special thanks to [Jane
McGonigal](https://el2.fourhourmail.com/c/o8uvgq544hqhke7vx/e1pnyl/aHR0cHM6Ly90d2l0dGVyLmNvbS9hdmFudGdhbWU=),
[Amelia
Boone](https://el2.fourhourmail.com/c/o8uvgq544hqhke7vx/41xkjn/aHR0cHM6Ly90d2l0dGVyLmNvbS9hbWVsaWFib29uZQ==),
[Matt
Mullenweg](https://el2.fourhourmail.com/c/o8uvgq544hqhke7vx/ly60ym/aHR0cHM6Ly90d2l0dGVyLmNvbS9waG90b21hdHQ=),
[Sameer Al-
Sakran](https://el2.fourhourmail.com/c/o8uvgq544hqhke7vx/gykm1o/aHR0cHM6Ly93d3cubGlua2VkaW4uY29tL2luL3NhbHNha3Jhbi8=)
(and my mock audience at
[Expa](https://el2.fourhourmail.com/c/o8uvgq544hqhke7vx/vj52jo/aHR0cHM6Ly9leHBhLmNvbS8=)),
and [Chris
Sacca](https://el2.fourhourmail.com/c/o8uvgq544hqhke7vx/412oy0/aHR0cHM6Ly90d2l0dGVyLmNvbS9zYWNjYQ==)
for their support.I totally understand if you’re too busy to share, but it
would mean the world to me. If you’d like to spread the word but are short on
time, here’s a simple template:“This is worth your time. Check out Tim
Ferriss’s new TED Talk about why you should define your fears:[
http://t.ted.com/SyodaXm”](https://el2.fourhourmail.com/c/o8uvgq544hqhke7vx/9yq3jg/aHR0cHM6Ly90LmNvL0JXdGpBSnd3NHE=)[If
helpful, I’m @tferriss on Twitter and @timferriss on Facebook and Instagram.
[Or you can retweet this, which has 2.6K likes so

This app was introduced to me by [Naval
Ravikant](https://el2.fourhourmail.com/c/o8uvgq544hqhke7vx/qjnejk/aHR0cDovL3RpbS5ibG9nLzIwMTUvMDgvMTgvdGhlLWV2b2x1dGlvbmFyeS1hbmdlbC1uYXZhbC1yYXZpa2FudC8=)’s

at-a-glance view of your weekly and monthly calendar. Specifically, click on
“Views” in the bottom navigation bar and choose “Mini Month.” It’s the fastest
way I’ve found to get the gist of your upcoming schedule.**

bullets.title: This Hedge Fund Manager Bets He Can Dull Your Sweet Tooth
bullets.note:
(Bloomberg)  
One of the investors who seeded Dr. Michael Burry -- remember _The Big Short_?
-- years later found a solution for his own sugar cravings, and now he’s out
to convert the world. He doesn’t need the money, and now he doesn’t need candy
bars, either. If you want to skip the text and test drive the lozenge (gymnema
sylvestre (GS) + zinc), [here it
is](https://el2.fourhourmail.com/c/o8uvgq544hqhke7vx/7yw413/aHR0cHM6Ly93d3cuYW1hem9uLmNvbS9DcmF2ZS1DcnVzaC0xNS1jb3VudC9kcC9CMDZYUThaTFhO).
I’ve grown interested in GS, as it appears it may not only blunt perception of
sweetness, but also affect [post-meal (postprandial) glycemic
response](https://el2.fourhourmail.com/c/o8uvgq544hqhke7vx/x1rx19/aHR0cHM6Ly93d3cubmNiaS5ubG0ubmloLmdvdi9wdWJtZWQvMjg0MzEwOTE=).**Most
